variants.headline: Building project badly behind schedule
variants.body:
The project {project} is badly behind schedule. The delay is the established failure against its timetable, not a complete account of why it occurred. Readers considering {target} should distinguish that known position from invented shortages, contractor disputes or financial consequences not supplied in the report.

A severe delay is a delivery issue, not automatically a quantified cost overrun. Managers should distinguish the schedule position from an assumed financial effect. Commercial scrutiny should concern the actual obligations and delivery record, without filling an incomplete account with a guessed penalty, cause or revised completion date.

The stewardship of {target} warrants scrutiny against the severe delay. This report does not assign an unreported cause or presume that lateness means the project has been abandoned rather than delayed. Reliable assessment begins with particulars rather than a politically convenient assumption.

variants.sub: The project {project} is badly behind schedule.
variants.body:

A severe delay is a delivery issue, not automatically a quantified cost overrun. Managers should distinguish the schedule position from an assumed financial effect.
